name: Lamplight
intro: The lamps along the harbour road want filling before dusk, and my old legs want a rest. Get yourself a trap, drive the road down to the docks, and tell me it's lit.

steps.text: Summon a pony trap (Wren sells the deed)
Tell Wren the harbour road is lit

outro: Lit end to end! Keep the trap; a lamplighter's errand-runner needs wheels.
